id: title:frankh:move catalog type descriptions to tooltips

review.posthog_relevance: Adds Tooltip component and accessibility attributes to the MetricsCatalog UI, supporting the display and interaction of metric tags.
review.reason: The chunk demonstrates a localized UI implementation: importing the Tooltip component and restructuring the DOM to support an accessible, tooltip-triggered metric tag. This is a bounded, substantive change to the frontend rendering and accessibility of metric metadata.
review.uncertainty: This chunk does not include the implementation of the new Tooltip component, the describeMetric helper, or the describeMetric function. It also does not include the implementation of the openMetric function or the openMetric prop. It does not include the implementation of the retrySparkline function or the retrySparkline prop. It does not include the implementation of the loadSpark

observations.code_quote: import { LemonButton, LemonInput, LemonSkeleton, LemonTag, Tooltip } from '@posthog/lemon-ui'
observations.posthog_connection: Adds Tooltip component to the component's dependencies, which is used later in P1.F2.H2 to wrap the metric tag.

observations.behavior: Changes the card container's className and adds an absolute positioned button with an aria-label, while moving the content into a relative z-10 container with pointer-events-none, and wrapping the tag in a Tooltip with openOnClick.
observations.code_quote: <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col gap-2 p-3 text-left pointer-events-none">
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the card's layout and accessibility. The card container no longer has the border and rounded classes, and the button is now absolute positioned. The content is moved into a relative z-10 container with pointer-events-none, and the tag is wrapped in a Tooltip with openOnClick.
